verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨ ਰਚੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜ ਦਿਸੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: horat ra(n)g na racheeaai sabh kooR dhisa(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Love none but the Guru; all other love is false.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਤੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਸੁਲ ਗੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: horat saadh na lageeaai hoi visul ga(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Enjoy no other relish than his, for it would be poisonous.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਤੁ ਰਾਗ ਨ ਰੀਝੀਐ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਨ ਲਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: horat raag na reejheeaai sun sukh na laha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Be not pleased with any one else's singing, for listening to it would bring no happiness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਬੁਰੀ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਹੈ ਲਗੈ ਫਲੁ ਮੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: hor buree karatoot hai lagai fal ma(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: All acts not in conformity with the Guru's teaching, are evil, and bear evil fruit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਤੁ ਪੰਥਿ ਨ ਚਲੀਐ ਠਗੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: horat pa(n)th na chaleeaai Thag chor muha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Walk only in the way of true Guru, because in all other ways, there are thieves who cheat and rob.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾਂ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੰਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit_en: peer mureedhaa(n) pirahaRee sach sach mila(n)dhaa ||11||

en.bdb: The love of the Guru's Sikhs for the Guru causes their soul to blend their truth with the Truth.
